00463.label: Doxorubicin/cisplatin treatment weeks

medicines.name: Individual anti-sickness and protective prescription
medicines.dose: Prescribed and reconciled by the specialist team
medicines.timing: The prescription specifies treatment-day, delayed and rescue support
medicines.note: Cisplatin has high nausea/vomiting risk; doxorubicin and high-dose methotrexate have moderate risk. Each visit needs its own reconciled anti-sickness prescription. Methotrexate hydration, alkalinisation, level monitoring and folinic acid rescue must continue until the specialist team confirms safe clearance. Delayed clearance may need intensified rescue or glucarpidase. No fixed discharge day is promised. Low blood counts or a delay to the next chemotherapy dose must not automatically withhold or stop folinic acid rescue for methotrexate already given.

00100.label: First 12 weeks: two infusions at least 3 days apart

medicines.name: Individual anti-sickness and protective prescription
medicines.dose: Prescribed and reconciled by the specialist team
medicines.timing: The prescription specifies treatment-day, delayed and rescue support
medicines.note: Mifamurtide has moderate nausea/vomiting risk. Agree an individual anti-sickness plan without automatically adding routine dexamethasone or chronic steroids, which may oppose immune-cell activation. Paracetamol or an antihistamine may be prescribed for infusion symptoms; adult examples are not paediatric doses. Preventive inhaler treatment may be considered for asthma or chronic obstructive lung disease.

Confirm complete removal of all visible tumour, nonmetastatic eligibility and recovery from surgery. Calcineurin inhibitors such as ciclosporin and high-dose nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory painkillers must not be combined with mifamurtide. Check with oncology or the pharmacist before taking, starting, changing or stopping any medicine, including over-the-counter products; do not stop prescribed medicines yourself. Routine or chronic corticosteroids should be avoided, but emergency use is a separate medical decision. Any premedication requires an individual prescription, especially for a child. Arrange the separate 36-week treatment record.

00596.label: Five-day etoposide/ifosfamide course and post-treatment support

medicines.name: Individual anti-sickness and protective prescription
medicines.dose: Prescribed and reconciled by the specialist team
medicines.timing: The prescription specifies treatment-day, delayed and rescue support
medicines.note: This combination has high overall nausea/vomiting risk and requires white-cell growth-factor support for every cycle, timed by local prescription. Mesna reduces bladder injury but does not protect the kidneys or brain. Pharmacy must review anti-sickness interactions, particularly aprepitant, and specify all delayed and rescue treatment.
